notes.UMI: Resolved 2026-07-03 from dedicated claim file 'UMI warranty data 202301 - 202605 (1).xlsx' (01_data/ root). CY2025 (calendar) = sum of 'Approved part cost' per line item where Written Date_YMD in 20250101-20251231 (12,042 lines / 201 claims). Matches the fiscal-year figure independently computed in distributor_warranty_expense_fiscal.csv (FY24/25/26 = 2,902,813/1,504,142/1,633,086) to the euro, confirming the source. Prior 0 was a genuine data gap (Israel LCV rows missing from the network-wide LCV warranty export), not a true zero.
